thread:
evan (sales): Quick ask — CloudScale wants a two-day POC weekend. Needs ephemeral Dedicated pool, 3 reserved GPUs with burst to 9 for two 45-min press demo slots each day, rotated hosted API key with IP allowlist, and optional VPC peering if security signs off. Need feasibility + rough cost.

priya (solutions): Can you share model and expected seq lengths? Also will the demo be public-facing (external users)?

evan (sales): Model: redwood-7b-quant, seq typically 256 but they have a single workflow that can hit 1024. Demo is public-facing, ~120 concurrent viewers when we open link.

omar (eng-infra): We can do ephemeral pool with burst. Suggest reserved=3, burst_max=9, burst_window=45m twice/day, autoscale cooldown 4m. For public demo we should use prewarm=2 slots to keep tail latency low. Need demo windows and either CIDR list (for peering) or IPs to allowlist.

zara (eng-runtime): For 7b quant with 1024 occasionally, enabling KV prefix cache + continuous batching will keep costs manageable. Recommend soft-fallback to redwood-3b if queue > 90s. Also pin model revision to avoid rollouts.

hugo (security): For peering we need completed security questionnaire and their infra contact. If they go allowlist, we issue ephemeral API key with 72h TTL, scope limited to the poc project, and IP allowlist. Also require that any demo assets hosted on their side are not sending secrets to our endpoints.

sylvie (finance): Preliminary cost: reserved 3 GPUs x 2 days + prewarm = ~144 GPU-hrs reserved, possible burst up to ~108 GPU-hrs. Very rough estimate $1.5k-$4k depending on burst. I can approve a $1k buffer; please escalate if we forecast >$3k.

priya (solutions): I'll put together a minimal runbook and CLI snippet. Proposed command: 

```
rictl pool create \
  --name cloudscale-weekend-poc \
  --reserved 3 \
  --prewarm 2 \
  --burst-max 9 \
  --burst-windows "45m,45m" \
  --schedule "2026-06-12T10:00Z/2026-06-14T02:00Z" \
  --rbac "team:cloudscale-poc" \
  --notes "ephemeral weekend poc; rotated key; ip allowlist or peering; monitoring + kill-switch"
```

infra-bot: created INFRA-POC-5233 assigned to omar (eng-infra)

omar (eng-infra): I'll provision after we receive: final demo windows, IP allowlist or peering decision + CIDR, security questionnaire completion if peering, and finance buffer confirmation. ETA: provision within 36hrs of inputs.

hugo (security): I'll drop the questionnaire here. If they want peering we need answers and signed peering terms at least 48hrs before demo. Otherwise allowlist and ephemeral key is fastest.

sylvie (finance): Approving $1k buffer. Notify me if forecasted burst looks like it will exceed $3k.

evan (sales): I'll request CIDRs and the network contact today. Priya — go ahead and prepare the runbook and monitoring dashboards; include token-cost alert and a manual burst disable.

zara (eng-runtime): Noted — we'll enable token-level tracing and expose a kill switch in the console for the sales lead. We'll also pin model v2.1.

omar (eng-infra): Nothing else blocking from infra after the inputs above. I'll update INFRA-POC-5233 when pool is created.

evan (sales): Thanks all — aiming for infra ready by 2026-06-10 for a dry-run. :rocket:
